messages:
lina-support: Heads-up — Acme (acct: ACME-402) downgraded mid-cycle from Pro -> Standard. They submitted a PO and explicitly need a formal credit note for the difference (legal/purchasing requirement). Can billing/finance advise approach?
omar-billing: Thanks Lina. Do we have the original invoice #INV-2026-0556 and the PO number on file? Also need to confirm whether refund goes back to card or as a credit note applied to next invoice.
lina-support: Invoice INV-2026-0556 present, PO# PO-8892 attached to ticket. Customer says card on file expired; they want a credit note so their purchasing team can reconcile.
alex-cs: Customer says their AP team requires VAT-inclusive credit note with PO number and line-level description (service period, SKU). They explicitly said bank refund is not acceptable.
omar-billing: Ok — sounds like we must issue a credit note (not refund). Need finance sign-off for tax handling (EU VAT). Nora, can you confirm VAT calc and whether we should reverse the invoice or issue a standalone credit note?
nora-finance: Quick read: This is a mid-cycle downgrade effective 2026-03-15. Original invoice covered 2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-31 (monthly). Pro plan USD 200.00/mo, Standard USD 120.00/mo. Prorate for remaining days after change = 17 days (3/15->3/31 inclusive? we'll use 17). Promo credit of USD 10 applied on original invoice (non-refundable policy flag), and customer is EU-UK VAT registered? They provided a UK VAT number in the PO. Need copy for reverse-charge? :thinking_face:
lina-support: They included VAT ID in PO: GB999999973. The PO explicitly requests VAT shown on the credit note.
nora-finance: Ok — since they provided a valid VAT ID, we treat this as B2B — VAT reversed (net amounts on invoices) if reverse-charge applies. But customer requested VAT-inclusive credit note for their AP team; we can show net and VAT lines, zero VAT if reverse-charge, but we must include VAT ID and a note: 'reverse charge applies'.
omar-billing: I'll prepare the credit note draft. Lina — please confirm the exact effective date to use on the credit note (we'll use 2026-03-15 unless customer says otherwise).
lina-support: Confirmed 2026-03-15.

--- calculation block ---

nora-finance: Calculation steps (rounded to cents):
```
Original plan: USD 200.00 (monthly)
New plan:      USD 120.00 (monthly)
Delta:         USD 80.00 credit per full month
Days remaining: 17 of 31 days in March (we invoice using actual-days)
Prorated credit (gross): 80 * 17/31 = 43.87 USD
Promo applied to invoice: 10.00 USD (non-refundable) -> reduces refundable amount by 10 if promo consumed against the period being credited
Net refundable before VAT: 43.87 - 10.00 = 33.87 USD
VAT / Reverse charge: 0.00 (reverse charge, show VAT line 0.00 + VAT ID)
Credit note total: 33.87 USD credit applied to customer account
```

omar-billing: Two process options: (A) Issue credit note in Stripe/ledger and apply to next invoice (preferred per PO), (B) Issue credit note + pay out refund to card (needs valid card + CFO approval). Customer wants A.
lina-support: They want the credit note emailed to AP with PO# and VAT ID shown.
billing-bot: Created draft credit note: CN-2026-0098 (status: draft) with metadata: {account: ACME-402, related_invoice: INV-2026-0556, po_number: PO-8892}

nora-finance: A couple of compliance checks before finalizing:
- Confirm promo non-refundability is documented in invoice metadata (yes).
- Ensure credit note references original invoice and includes line-level reversal (service period 2026-03-15 -> 2026-03-31).
- Attach customer's PO PDF to CN.
- Add accounting tag: AR-REVERSE/UK-VAT.
omar-billing: I'll attach PO + VAT ID, update description. Draft ready for finance approval.

omar-billing: Also noticed the original invoice was paid via card on 3/02 and settled. Since customer refuses refund to card, we'll post the credit note to their account balance. Any objections?
nora-finance: None. Approve issuance of CN-2026-0098 for 33.87 USD credit (reverse-charge). Please ensure posting creates a negative invoice entry and ledger reconciliation for March close.
lina-support: I'll notify customer AP when it's final. Alex, please prepare the email body with PO and CN details.
alex-cs: Drafting email now. Quick Q: customer asked for 'line-level unit price' on CN — should we itemize as 'Pro (prorated 17d)' with quantity 1?
omar-billing: Yes, itemize: SKU PRO-MONTHLY, period 2026-03-01->2026-03-15 (credit) with unit amount -43.87, then promo adjustment -10.00, then total -33.87. Include PO# and VAT ID.

--- audit entries / commands ---

nora-finance: When posting, use these ledger notes to avoid downstream mismatch:
```
GL: AccountsReceivable -33.87 CN-2026-0098
GL: Revenue          -43.87 CN-2026-0098 (reversal of service revenue portion)
GL: Discounts/Promo  +10.00 CN-2026-0098 (promo redemption applied)
```

nora-finance: After posting, run the reconciliation job for INV-2026-0556 to ensure net open balance = 0.
omar-billing: Will do. Posting scheduled in 30m, will mark CN as 'issued' and email AP with PDF. billing-bot: CN-2026-0098 status -> issued; emailed to acme-ap@acme.example.com (attachment: CN-2026-0098.pdf)
lina-support: Customer confirmed receipt of CN PDF and will route to AP for reconciliation. Marking this thread for closure once ledger is reconciled.

--- follow-ups / edge cases ---

alex-cs: FYI — customer later raised that the promo they used was tied to the Pro plan only and should not reduce the credit for a downgrade. We should confirm promo policy.
nora-finance: Policy: 'one-time promo applied to billed period is non-refundable' — that stands. But if promo specifically targeted new plan SKU and never applied, we can reverse. For this case it's applied, so we keep the deduction.
omar-billing: Noted. If customer disputes, we'll re-open. For now CN issued and posted.

billing-bot: Ledger reconciliation job completed: INV-2026-0556 reconciled at 1776543599.
lina-support: Thanks everyone. Closing thread after finance posts final journal entries. :white_check_mark:
